name: Mutation Titration
description:
Before going any further you really should craft a lot,[note] and I mean a lot[/note], of crop sticks. Hope you like chopping trees and crafting saws! §o§oYou should've seen the old recipe...

§o§rEach of the adjacent quest groupings represent a different category of crops found within the mod. If you haven't yet, I would highly recommend you review the in depth guide quests focusing on [warn]Crop Stats[/warn] and [warn]Crop Nutrients[/warn].

While not every crop will produce a useful harvest, they very well may deterministically breed into a useful crop or open up a useful pool. So don't throw away new species just because they don't seem immediately useful.

Certain crops need more than just two parents to breed. For those crops, simply surround a single double cropstick with all 3-4 crops needed and continue as normal.

[note]Be free farmhand~![/note]
